references.text: The priest who offers the sin offering shall eat it in a holy place, in the court of the tabernacle.
All male priests may eat from the guilt offering, and it must be eaten in a holy place.
Moses rebukes Aaron and his sons because they did not eat the sin offering in the holy place as they were commanded.
Describes the priest's role in offering a sin offering to make atonement.
The priests' portion of the most holy offerings shall be eaten in a holy place by all male descendants.
Ezekiel describes that the priests shall eat the most holy offerings in the holy chambers.
The priests shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.
